verdict.rationale: Cal.com names "workflows" as a platform feature, and a community report confirms Workflows exist as an enterprise-edition feature removed from Cal.diy, but the evidence never describes how rules or actions are defined. What is documented is event-triggered automation: event-type webhooks with a trigger enum (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_PAID, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED and others) and a customizable payload template sent to a subscriber URL. The listed Zapier app automates on booking events, but through an external tool. Missing for 10: documentation of Workflows rule definition (conditions and actions such as reminders or emails), native configurable actions beyond outbound webhooks, and agent/API access to create automation rules.
